change.source: Qualifies the test_result of 2026-09-15T07:42:51Z: that was a machine-local task check on the operator's laptop, which has metaharness and b10x-harness installed. Gate run 34947429804 ran the same task check on 4a21dcc — the commit carrying that record — and exited non-zero at crates/metaharness-cli/tests/aep_resume.rs:70, 'this map has 1 llm step(s) and metaharness is not on PATH'. That is a machine dependency of the test, not the b10x pin: the pin's own evidence is unaffected and the story stays implemented. CI verification is pending on the fix recorded against story:task-check-passes-on-a-machine-without-the-operators-binaries.
